title: 某团队在 bioRxiv 发表细菌热适应与 GroEL 编码序列关系研究
originalTitle: Chaperone mRNA secondary structure does not strongly track thermal adaptation in bacteria, but groL coding sequence shortens in its disordered C-terminal tail
summary: 某团队在 bioRxiv 发表研究，发现高温下细菌 GroEL 编码序列平均缩短 9.8 字节（Cliff's δ = 0.571, P = 5.1×10^-4），且该变化与热适应温度呈负相关（每升高 1°C 缩短 0.356 字节）。

story.title: 细菌热适应关联GroEL编码序列缩短及温度负相关研究发布

author: Singh, S., Sahu, V., Sradha, S., Dhiman, V.
